title: Hardware Problems
drDigitalIntro:
Hardware problems are issues with the physical parts of your computer — the screen, keyboard, ports, or speakers.
• A dim or completely black screen: first check the brightness in Settings; if the screen still won't turn on, check that the charger is connected and the battery isn't empty.
• A keyboard or mouse that isn't responding: check the cable is firmly plugged in, or replace the batteries if it is wireless.
• No sound: check that the volume is turned up and not muted in Settings; try a different speaker or pair of headphones to rule out a broken device.
• Strange smells, smoke, sparks, or a cracked screen: stop using the computer immediately and take it to a repair shop. Do not attempt to fix physical damage yourself.
• The safe rule: try Settings and cables first. If the problem persists after a restart, get professional help.
drDigitalSuccess: You know how to spot hardware problems and what to try first!
